subject: Operational evidence for tenant-scoped purge - dedicated deployment (US-WEST-2)
messages:
From: Rajiv Menon <security@finregcorp.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence required: tenant-scoped purge & backups for dedicated instance

Diego,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our procurement & security check I need explicit operational evidence for how Redwood handles a tenant-scoped purge and how backups and snapshots are scoped for our dedicated deployment in us-west-2. Specifically we need:

- Confirmation that FinRegCorp tenancy is pinned to us-west-2 (no automatic cross-region replication).
- Proof that backups/snapshots for our tenant are stored only within the same region and encrypted with our customer-managed KMS key. Please include the KMS key alias/ID used.
- The lifecycle for a deletion request: soft-delete (tombstone) retention, physical wipe timeline, and whether any geo-redundant copies exist.
- Audit artifacts we can review: backup manifest (object listing), wipe job audit log, and the runbook that operators follow for a manual/one-off purge.

Can you provide these items or a plan + timeline? Our internal auditors would like this by EOD Wednesday if possible.

Regards,
Rajiv Menon
VP, Information Security
FinRegCorp
security@finregcorp.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <security@finregcorp.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence required: tenant-scoped purge & backups for dedicated instance

Hi Rajiv — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you requested; summary below and I attached our ops playbook excerpt that covers purge steps.

Quick answers up front:
- Region pinning: FinRegCorp's Dedicated deployment is pinned to us-west-2 (no cross-region replication by default).
- Encryption: Tenant data at rest and snapshots are encrypted with the customer-managed KMS key (alias/finreg-prod). I'll include the KMS policy excerpt.
- Deletion lifecycle: tombstone (soft-delete) metadata retained for 24 hours by default, then queued for physical wipe; physical media wipe completes within 72 hours of request in normal operations.

Requested artifacts we will provide: backup manifest (object list), wipe audit log (job id + timestamp), and the operator runbook. Marcus will run a one-off scrub and upload the audit log; target delivery tomorrow afternoon.

Attachments: ops_playbook_wipe_steps.pdf (excerpt)

Action items:
- Marcus: run one-off purge on a test tenant replica and collect manifest + audit log (target 2027-07-20).
- Diego: provide KMS policy excerpt and confirm alias/ID.
- Lauren: confirm this cadence meets FinRegCorp auditor timeline.

If you need additional cryptographic proofs (HSM attestation, key rotation records) let me know and we can add those to the package.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Jul 19, 2027 at 13:45, Rajiv Menon <security@finregcorp.com> wrote:
> Hi Diego —
>
> Thanks. A few follow-ups from our security team:
>
> 1) For tombstone retention: is 24 hours configurable? Our retention policy requires soft-delete logs be retained for 7 days for forensic review before permanent wipe.
> 2) For KMS: we need the exact key ID and the policy showing that Redwood's operators do not have key expansion privileges. Can you provide the key ID for alias/finreg-prod or an export of the key policy?
> 3) Backups: confirm whether automated snapshots (nightly) are retained long-term in the same region or if snapshots are periodically exported (we need assurance they are not copied outside us-west-2).
>
> If you can provide those three items with the manifests/audit logs that will likely satisfy our auditors.
>
> Rajiv
> VP, Information Security, FinRegCorp
>
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <security@finregcorp.com>, diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence required: tenant-scoped purge & backups for dedicated instance

Rajiv — attaching the artifacts we discussed. Summary and provenance below.

Attachments included:
- backup_manifest_usw2_20270719.json (S3 object listing for FinRegCorp tenant prefixes, region: us-west-2)
- wipe_job_20270720_audit.log (one-off scrub run against replica env; job id: wipe-job-8c9f2a; started 2027-07-20T14:12:02-07:00; completed 2027-07-20T14:42:11-07:00)
- kms_policy_finreg_20270720.pdf (policy excerpt showing key usage constraints; key id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/3f2b9b8a-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxx)

Key points and evidence chain:
- Region pinning: deployment config for FinRegCorp explicitly sets region = us-west-2; automated replication jobs are disabled. Manifest shows all backup ARNs in us-west-2.
- KMS: snapshots/backups encrypted with customer key alias/finreg-prod (KMS ARN above). Policy shows principal restrictions and no redwood-operator privileges to export key material.
- Tombstone & wipe windows: default soft-delete metadata retention = 24h (configurable per-customer). For FinRegCorp we've set an extended policy to retain soft-delete entries for 7 days before physical wipe; that is reflected in the config attached. The one-off scrub executed follows the runbook in ops_playbook_wipe_steps.pdf and produced the audit log above.

Next steps:
- If you want, we can produce an S3 transient object deletion receipt (expunged object listing) and a signed HMAC of the audit log for non-repudiation.
- I can also schedule a short call with our infra engineer to walk through the manifests.

Let me know if anything else is needed.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
